name: Tokunoshima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tokunoshima town emblem in maroon: a ring open at the fly with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tokunoshima, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1964.

features.role: Tokunoshima town emblem — a ring open at the fly with a stylised character
